entries.43b4f53c212b20e8: Japan Communications Inc. was founded in 1996 in Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo, and has its head office in Minato-ku, Tokyo. It has six consolidated subsidiaries and one equity-method affiliate, and its consolidated number of employees was 156 as of March 31, 2026.
entries.51b240354f3c43f8: In Japan, this business provides mobile solutions tailored to the requirements of corporate customers, or of partners such as MVNOs, financial institutions, payment agencies, system integrators and manufacturers. Services began in January 2016. Through collaboration with payment agencies, it also offers services supporting non-retention of credit card information, and provides SIMs for local 5G to companies, educational institutions and others.
entries.5980371f94cf9bce: Fees for communication services and platform provision to partner MVNOs
entries.5c658d8932c90924: This business provides mobile communications services tailored to each partner's requirements to partners that operate MVNO businesses mainly for individual customers. As a partner platform, it supports partners' MVNO businesses by providing communications networks, communication devices, authentication systems, billing and invoicing systems, customer management systems and others, and also entrusts network management, call center, logistics and other operations. Services began in November 2014.

entries.897f984f0986988e: Revenue rose from ¥4,634 million in the fiscal year ended March 2022 to ¥11,633 million in the fiscal year ended March 2026. Contracted lines for 'Japan Communications SIM' were 947,000 lines at the end of March 2026. The company does not own mobile base stations; it is an MVNO that provides services by procuring the networks of NTT Docomo and SoftBank Corp. through interconnection and wholesale. By procuring both its data network and its voice and SMS networks through interconnection, it secures a stable business foundation, and it aims to become a 'Neocarrier' able to provide services equivalent to those of an MNO.
entries.8f0d6e22e34b8d2a: This business provides mobile communications services tailored to each partner's requirements to partners that operate MVNO businesses mainly for individual customers.
entries.945d9f4e25806316: For voice call services, under a ruling by the Minister of Internal Affairs and Communications, the fees for wholesale telecommunications services that NTT Docomo provides to the company are set at no more than an amount equal to appropriate cost under efficient management plus a reasonable profit, and the company states that this secures competitiveness able to stand up against MNOs and other MVNOs. Also, the patented technology FPoS has been recognized, after a FinTech demonstration experiment by the Financial Services Agency, as satisfying the security requirements sought under the Financial Services Agency's supervisory guidelines, and it enables identity verification and user authentication on smartphones with security equivalent to My Number Card.

It offers secure networks using dedicated mobile lines, dual-network products with redundancy through multi-carrier connectivity, device monitoring services, SIMs for local 5G and others.
entries.a21a324d61d678e9: This business provides mobile solutions in Japan and the United States by using the mobile communications networks of mobile carriers and others.
entries.a3044f49cf484b93: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥11,633 million, up from ¥9,238 million in the previous year. This is due to growth in voice flat-rate and quasi-flat-rate services, mainly the 'Japan Communications SIM'. As the group has a single segment, revenue by business is not disclosed.
entries.b1d35ae70c03526d: Under the brands "Japan Communications SIM" and "bmobile", this business mainly offers SIM-based internet connection services combined with voice call services and other services to individual customers. Services for individual customers began in December 2001. As of the end of March 2026, the number of lines under contract for "Japan Communications SIM" was 947 thousand. H.I.S.Mobile Co., Ltd., an equity-method affiliate, also operates an MVNO business using mobile networks in Japan.
entries.b7146869ba43d93d: Under the 'Japan Communications SIM' and 'b mobile' brands, it provides SIMs and communication services to individuals, and it operates the MVNE business, which supports the business operations of partner MVNOs, and the MSP business, which provides dedicated mobile lines and dual-network products to corporate customers.

entries.f4f4f01f4e234da2: A business conducted in the United States by the consolidated subsidiary JCI US Inc. Using Verizon Wireless's mobile communication network and other resources, it provides mobile solutions to corporate customers such as financial institutions or to partners such as system integrators. It provides a mobile dedicated-line service that completes End to End connections from terminals such as ATMs to payment centers over wireless dedicated lines, and also provides a "Hybrid SIM" for CBRS. The service started in November 2007.
entries.fa8f51f96d9cb556: This business provides mobile communications services as an MVNO or MVNE by using the mobile communications networks of mobile carriers (NTT DOCOMO and SoftBank). It operates in Japan.
entries.fc60e3ccae3a13f9: In May 2026, the company formulated 'Vision 2030', a medium- to long-term management policy looking ahead to fiscal 2030. It intends to grow both its communication services business and its digital trust business, which has the patented technology FPoS at its core. For the fiscal year ending March 2027, the first year of the Vision, it plans to begin offering new 'Neocarrier' services from November 2026, based on interconnection with NTT Docomo's voice and SMS networks, and it will also promote the spread of FPoS, whose commercial service has started, and strengthen the digital authentication infrastructure that is the source of its competitiveness. Among the issues to be addressed as a priority, it cites ensuring a fair competitive environment between MNOs and MVNOs, and securing stable revenue through the evolution of the MVNO business model.
